notes.title: Next Up Hero adds a new Hero and revamps Co-op!
notes.content:
Welcome to Early Access week 5 Heroes! We've got some big surprises this week!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29526960/8a9ccd2ddefc14a522ab5b29b670ca05b45bc700.jpg
Co-op Revamped!
We’ve heard your thoughts on Echo-op, and we’ve revamped the system! This system is new, and we wanted to push it out to the community as soon as possible, so there will be bugs. Please let us know of any issues via the NUH  Discord Channel or in this thread

Meet Jett
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29526960/e6575cf8aa1a0ab572b6ef6ed5c1426734822f77.png
For completing the Champion Trial, you’ve been awarded a new Hero, Jett! He dashes, he teleports, he has elemental buffs! Congratulations to our great community of Heroes for banding together and proving yourselves true Champions!

But that’s not all, there’s a new ancient, tuning, bug fixes, and much more! Read the full patch notes here.

Community Challenge: Streamer Thursday
This week, I want all of us to join together on Thursday @ 4:00 PM EST/1:00 PM PST. Everyone get together and STREAM! Let’s get Next Up Hero rising through the ranks of Twitch, Mixer, & YouTube.

If you’re new to streaming, just try using the streamer that’s integrated with the game launcher! All you have to do is click the Broadcast Button (Camera to the left of Play), then link your Twitch account. If you have questions, ask!

Meet the Aspyr Community Team LIVE on Mixer
Additionally, we’ll be kicking off our first stream on Mixer.com/AspyrMedia @ 4:00 PM EST on Thursday as well. If you’re not streaming, tune in!

notes.title: Early Access Week 4!
notes.content:
Heroes!

Community Highlight!
Have you been enjoying the Champion Trial? We’ve been watching as you’ve collaborated and solved a puzzle. ICYMI see this clip!

Feedback Target: Champion Trial
As you work through the Champion Trial, let us know your thoughts in the  Week 4 Feedback thread. What do you like? What can we improve on? Are there elements you’d like to see re-utilized in other parts of the game? Just drop your thoughts in this thread!

Next Update
The Champion Trial was a massive content drop for us! Now we’re aiming to have more frequent updates in Early Access as we continue to craft the ultimate Next Up Hero experience!

If you’re looking for a hint on what’s coming next, maybe the patch notes have a clue?

notes.title: Major Content Update And Champion Trial coming this afternoon!
notes.content:
Heroes!

We've listened, iterated, and pushed a new build out! Expect it to land around 7PM EST!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29526960/fd57078286133c7ee6d8da9c4715c000657c99d2.gif
What's new?!

Champion Trial is unlocked!
New enemies, including a new boss!
New enemies means new abilities!
Boss Treasure Chests! (AND a whole lotta loot)!
Changes to Co-Op with even more coming soon!
A ton of tuning and bug fixes based on your feedback on Steam and Discord
Full patch notes can be read here

Leave us a review with your thoughts!
We want your feedback! Leave a review on Steam so we can keep improving Next Up Hero to be the game! Several tuning and bug fixes are responses right to your thoughts during our first build in Early Access

notes.title: Early Access Week 3!
notes.content:
Heroes,

We’ve made it to Week 3 of Early Access! 

Week 3 Feedback Target: Account Progression
This week we’d like to hear your thoughts on account progression!

Let us know what you think about leveling, rewards, potential features, and everything between in this thread

Week 3 Community Challenge
I’m a Mixtape main, and I need a new desktop wallpaper. This week I’m challenging you to take the most epic Mixtape screenshot possible. Upload your screenshot to Steam (F12 to take one in-game), and post a link in the comments section!

I'm planning to use this as my wallpaper, so make it epic!

Join us on Steam and Discord
Don't forget to join the Community Group on Steam and the Community Discord.GG/NextUpHero ! Come meet other players, and help each other complete ventures!

New Player? Checkout the Hero’s Guide!
If you’re new to Next Up Hero, Deksam has put together this Guide to help you get started!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1280461629

notes.title: Early Access Week 2!
notes.content:
Heroes,

We’ve made it to Week 2 of Early Access! Last week we challenged you to post a boatload of screenshots (and we’ve seen some epic ones on the Hub). Here’s one of my favorites: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1266025361
Additionally, we asked you to provide feedback on Spectator Mode, and you did! We’re taking all of your thoughts to heart and working through some ideas. More information on that soon!


This week we’d like to hear your thoughts on the different play-styles in Next Up Hero. Do you have a favorite build? Do you prefer to get up close and personal? Or do you prefer to kite enemies on the outskirts of the level? Are you a hybrid player? We want to know!


Please let us know your thoughts about the different playstyles offered by the current melee, ranged, and hybrid characters in this thread


Week 2 Community Challenge
Next Up Hero is all about community, so tell a friend about Next Up Hero. Invite them to watch the Join The Fight Trailer, and share their thoughts in the comments section below! How many views can we rake up in a week heroes?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3jRI4pGDVH4

Join us on Steam and Discord
Don't forget to join the  Community Group on Steam and the Community Discord.GG/NextUpHero ! Come meet other players, and help each other complete ventures!


New Player? Checkout the Hero’s Guide!
If you’re new to Next Up Hero, we’ve put together the Hero’s Guide to kickstart your venture! Let us know what you’d like us to add to it!

notes.title: Early Access Week 1 (Welcome and Spectator Mode!)
notes.content:
Heroes,

Welcome to Next Up Hero Early Access!

We want to make the best experience possible, integrating user feedback as we march toward our final release. To do so, each week we're going to target an area of the game. So let's get started!

Week 1 Feedback Target: Spectator Mode

Please let us know your thoughts, suggestions, feedback, and ideas for Spectator Mode in this thread

Week 1 Community Challenge

Post 100 screenshots to the Hub!

Can we do it by Next Monday?

Discord

Don't forget to join the community on Discord.GG/NextUpHero ! Come meet other players, and help eachother complete ventures!
